sources.title: FP8-BERT: Post-Training Quantization for Transformer - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Recently, a new numeric format FP8 (i.e. floating-point of 8-bits) has been proposed and supported in commercial AI computing platforms such as H100. In this paper, we empirically validate the effectiveness of FP8 as a way to do Post-Training Quantization without significant loss of accuracy, with a simple calibration and format conversion process.
